        var odoo = ;

        (function () {
            var INSTANCE_ID = ;
            var POLL_MS     = 4000;
            var LINES       = 500;

            var allLines   = [];   // all fetched lines
            var query      = '';   // current search query
            var liveTimer  = null;

            var terminal    = document.getElementById('terminal');
            var svcSelect   = document.getElementById('svc-select');
            var searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
            var btnLive     = document.getElementById('btn-live');
            var statusEl    = document.getElementById('status-text');
            var lineCountEl = document.getElementById('line-count');
            var emptyMsg    = document.getElementById('empty-msg');
            var filterInfo  = document.getElementById('filter-info');
            var archiveWrap = document.getElementById('archive-wrap');
            var dayInput    = document.getElementById('day-input');
            var dayMenu     = document.getElementById('day-menu');
            var dayPrev     = document.getElementById('day-prev');
            var dayNext     = document.getElementById('day-next');
            var btnDownload = document.getElementById('btn-download');
            var searchHits  = document.getElementById('search-hits');

            /* Every day the host keeps, newest first, plus the hit
             * counts of the last cross-day search (day → count). */
            var days = [];
            var hits = {};
            var menuIndex = -1;

            /* Which file the viewer is showing: the live log (default)
             * or one of the days logrotate archived on the host. */
            var LIVE = 'odoo.log';
            var archive = LIVE;

            /* ── RPC ── */
            function rpc(method, params) {
                return fetch('/web/dataset/call_kw', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(),
                        params: {
                            model: 'cloud.instance', method: 'dummy',
                            args: [], kwargs: {},
                        },
                    }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
            }

            function fetchJson(url, body) {
                return fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(), params: body }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (r) { return r.result; });
            }

            /* ── ANSI SGR → styled spans ──
             * Docker compose logs stream ANSI escape sequences
             * (``\x1b[…m``) when the service uses a TTY. Without a
             * parser the ESC byte renders as a ▯ box in the middle
             * of every line. Same logic as in log_terminal_page.xml
             * — kept inline to avoid an asset bundle for a standalone
             * HTML page. */
            var ANSI_BASIC = {
                30:'#000', 31:'#e06060', 32:'#60c060', 33:'#e0c060', 34:'#6088e0', 35:'#c060c0', 36:'#4ec9b0', 37:'#d4d4d4',
                90:'#666', 91:'#f48771', 92:'#8ae066', 93:'#ffd060', 94:'#88aaff', 95:'#ff88ff', 96:'#88ffff', 97:'#fff'
            };
            function ansi256(n) {
                if (n < 16) return ANSI_BASIC[n < 8 ? 30 + n : 82 + n];
                if (n < 232) {
                    n -= 16;
                    var scale = [0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255];
                    return 'rgb(' + scale[Math.floor(n/36)] + ',' + scale[Math.floor((n%36)/6)] + ',' + scale[n%6] + ')';
                }
                var v = 8 + (n - 232) * 10;
                return 'rgb(' + v + ',' + v + ',' + v + ')';
            }
            function applyAnsiCodes(state, raw) {
                var codes = (raw === '' ? [0] : raw.split(';').map(function (x) { return parseInt(x, 10); }));
                for (var i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) {
                    var c = codes[i];
                    if (!isFinite(c) || c === 0)      { state.fg = null; state.bg = null; state.bold = false; state.dim = false; state.italic = false; state.underline = false; }
                    else if (c === 1)                 { state.bold = true; }
                    else if (c === 2)                 { state.dim = true; }
                    else if (c === 3)                 { state.italic = true; }
                    else if (c === 4)                 { state.underline = true; }
                    else if (c === 22)                { state.bold = false; state.dim = false; }
                    else if (c === 23)                { state.italic = false; }
                    else if (c === 24)                { state.underline = false; }
                    else if (c === 39)                { state.fg = null; }
                    else if (c === 49)                { state.bg = null; }
                    else if (c >= 30 && c <= 37)     { state.fg = ANSI_BASIC[c]; }
                    else if (c >= 40 && c <= 47)     { state.bg = ANSI_BASIC[c - 10]; }
                    else if (c >= 90 && c <= 97)     { state.fg = ANSI_BASIC[c]; }
                    else if (c >= 100 && c <= 107)   { state.bg = ANSI_BASIC[c - 10]; }
                    else if (c === 38 && codes[i+1] === 5) { state.fg = ansi256(codes[i+2] || 0); i += 2; }
                    else if (c === 48 && codes[i+1] === 5) { state.bg = ansi256(codes[i+2] || 0); i += 2; }
                    else if (c === 38 && codes[i+1] === 2) { state.fg = 'rgb(' + (codes[i+2]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+3]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+4]||0) + ')'; i += 4; }
                    else if (c === 48 && codes[i+1] === 2) { state.bg = 'rgb(' + (codes[i+2]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+3]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+4]||0) + ')'; i += 4; }
                }
            }
            function emitRun(parent, text, state) {
                if (!text) return;
                if (!state.fg && !state.bg && !state.bold && !state.dim && !state.italic && !state.underline) {
                    parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
                    return;
                }
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                var css = '';
                if (state.fg) css += 'color:' + state.fg + ';';
                if (state.bg) css += 'background:' + state.bg + ';';
                if (state.bold) css += 'font-weight:bold;';
                if (state.dim) css += 'opacity:0.65;';
                if (state.italic) css += 'font-style:italic;';
                if (state.underline) css += 'text-decoration:underline;';
                span.style.cssText = css;
                span.textContent = text;
                parent.appendChild(span);
            }
            function appendAnsiText(parent, text) {
                var re = /\x1b\[([0-9;]*)m/g;
                var state = { fg: null, bg: null, bold: false, dim: false, italic: false, underline: false };
                var last = 0;
                var m;
                while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
                    if (m.index > last) emitRun(parent, text.slice(last, m.index), state);
                    applyAnsiCodes(state, m[1]);
                    last = re.lastIndex;
                }
                if (last < text.length) emitRun(parent, text.slice(last), state);
            }

            /* ── Render ── */
            function render() {
                var filtered = query
                    ? allLines.filter(function (l) { return l.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1; })
                    : allLines;

                // remove old log lines (keep emptyMsg node)
                while (terminal.firstChild) terminal.removeChild(terminal.firstChild);
                terminal.appendChild(emptyMsg);

                if (filtered.length === 0) {
                    emptyMsg.style.display = '';
                    emptyMsg.textContent   = allLines.length ? 'No lines match the filter.' : 'No log output.';
                } else {
                    emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
                    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
                    filtered.forEach(function (line) {
                        var div = document.createElement('div');
                        div.className = 'log-line' + (query ? ' hl' : '');
                        appendAnsiText(div, line);
                        frag.appendChild(div);
                    });
                    terminal.appendChild(frag);
                }

                lineCountEl.textContent = (query
                    ? filtered.length + ' / ' + allLines.length
                    : allLines.length) + ' lines';

                if (query) {
                    filterInfo.style.display = '';
                    filterInfo.textContent   = 'Filtering: "' + query + '"';
                } else {
                    filterInfo.style.display = 'none';
                }

                // always scroll to bottom
                terminal.scrollTop = terminal.scrollHeight;
            }

            /* ── Fetch logs ── */
            function fetchLogs() {
                var svc = svcSelect.value;
                if (!svc) return;
                setStatus('loading', 'Loading…');
                fetchJson('/cloud/fetch_container_logs', {
                    instance_id: INSTANCE_ID,
                    service:     svc,
                    lines:       LINES,
                }).then(function (result) {
                    if (!result) { setStatus('error', 'No response.'); return; }
                    if (result.ok) {
                        allLines = result.lines || [];
                        render();
                        setStatus('', svc + ' — ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
                    } else {
                        setStatus('error', result.error || 'Error.');
                    }
                }).catch(function () {
                    setStatus('error', 'Connection error.');
                });
            }

            function setStatus(cls, text) {
                statusEl.className    = cls;
                statusEl.textContent  = text;
            }

            /* ── Odoo log archive ──
             * Docker keeps a container's output only until the
             * container is replaced, and a rebuild replaces it by
             * design. Odoo therefore writes to a file on the host that
             * logrotate turns into one dated file per day. Sixty days
             * of those do not fit a dropdown, so the picker filters as
             * you type and the filter box can sweep every day at once
             * — "which day was it" is the question, and scrolling is
             * not an answer to it. */
            function humanSize(bytes) {
                if (!bytes) return '0 B';
                var units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
                var i = 0;
                while (bytes >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { bytes /= 1024; i++; }
                return (i === 0 ? bytes : bytes.toFixed(1)) + ' ' + units[i];
            }

            function dayOf(name) {
                return name === LIVE
                    ? ''
                    : name.replace(/^odoo\.log\./, '').replace(/\.gz$/, '');
            }

            function archiveLabel(entry) {
                if (entry.name === LIVE) return 'Today (live)';
                var day = dayOf(entry.name);
                var yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000)
                    .toISOString().slice(0, 10);
                return day === yesterday ? day + ' (yesterday)' : day;
            }

            function showArchiveControls(show) {
                archiveWrap.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
                btnDownload.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
            }

            function currentEntry() {
                return days.filter(function (d) { return d.name === archive; })[0];
            }

            function syncDayInput() {
                var entry = currentEntry();
                dayInput.value = entry ? archiveLabel(entry) : '';
                var idx = days.map(function (d) { return d.name; }).indexOf(archive);
                /* days[] is newest first, so "previous day" is further
                 * down the list and "next" further up. */
                dayPrev.disabled = idx < 0 || idx >= days.length - 1;
                dayNext.disabled = idx <= 0;
            }

            function closeMenu() {
                dayMenu.hidden = true;
                menuIndex = -1;
                syncDayInput();
            }

            function renderMenu(filter) {
                var q = (filter || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                var shown = days.filter(function (entry) {
                    if (!q) return true;
                    return archiveLabel(entry).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
                });
                while (dayMenu.firstChild) dayMenu.removeChild(dayMenu.firstChild);
                if (!shown.length) {
                    var none = document.createElement('div');
                    none.className = 'day-empty';
                    none.textContent = 'No day matches "' + q + '".';
                    dayMenu.appendChild(none);
                } else {
                    shown.forEach(function (entry, i) {
                        var row = document.createElement('div');
                        row.className = 'day-opt' + (i === menuIndex ? ' active' : '');
                        row.dataset.name = entry.name;
                        var label = document.createElement('span');
                        label.textContent = archiveLabel(entry);
                        var meta = document.createElement('span');
                        meta.className = 'meta';
                        meta.textContent = humanSize(entry.size);
                        if (hits[entry.name]) {
                            var hit = document.createElement('span');
                            hit.className = 'hits';
                            hit.textContent = hits[entry.name] + ' hits';
                            label.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
                            label.appendChild(hit);
                        }
                        row.appendChild(label);
                        row.appendChild(meta);
                        /* mousedown, not click: the input's blur closes
                         * the menu and would beat a click to it. */
                        row.addEventListener('mousedown', function (ev) {
                            ev.preventDefault();
                            selectDay(entry.name);
                        });
                        dayMenu.appendChild(row);
                    });
                }
                dayMenu.hidden = false;
                dayMenu._shown = shown;
            }

            function selectDay(name) {
                archive = name;
                closeMenu();
                allLines = [];
                render();
                if (archive === LIVE) { fetchLogs(); } else { stopLive(); fetchArchive(); }
            }

            function stepDay(delta) {
                var names = days.map(function (d) { return d.name; });
                var idx = names.indexOf(archive);
                if (idx < 0) return;
                var next = idx + delta;
                if (next < 0 || next >= names.length) return;
                selectDay(names[next]);
            }

            function loadArchives() {
                if (svcSelect.value !== 'odoo') {
                    showArchiveControls(false);
                    return Promise.resolve();
                }
                return fetchJson('/cloud/instance_log_archives', {
                    instance_id: INSTANCE_ID,
                }).then(function (res) {
                    if (!res || !res.ok || !res.archived) {
                        /* Not rebuilt since file logging shipped: the
                         * container's own output is all there is. */
                        showArchiveControls(false);
                        return;
                    }
                    days = res.archives || [];
                    hits = {};
                    archive = LIVE;
                    showArchiveControls(true);
                    syncDayInput();
                }).catch(function () { showArchiveControls(false); });
            }

            function fetchArchive() {
                setStatus('loading', 'Loading ' + archive + '…');
                fetchJson('/cloud/fetch_log_archive', {
                    instance_id: INSTANCE_ID,
                    name:        archive,
                    lines:       LINES,
                    /* Grep on the host: a day of logs is megabytes and
                     * the answer is usually a handful of lines. */
                    search:      query,
                }).then(function (result) {
                    if (!result) { setStatus('error', 'No response.'); return; }
                    if (result.ok) {
                        allLines = result.lines || [];
                        render();
                        setStatus('', archive + ' — last ' + allLines.length + ' matching lines');
                    } else {
                        setStatus('error', result.error || 'Error.');
                    }
                }).catch(function () { setStatus('error', 'Connection error.'); });
            }

            /* ── Search every day at once ──
             * The filter box only sees what is loaded; this asks the
             * host which days mention the term, so finding the day of
             * an incident does not depend on guessing its date. */
            function searchAllDays() {
                if (!query || query.length < 2) {
                    setStatus('error', 'Type at least two characters to search all days.');
                    return;
                }
                setStatus('loading', 'Searching every day for "' + query + '"…');
                fetchJson('/cloud/search_log_archives', {
                    instance_id: INSTANCE_ID,
                    term:        query,
                }).then(function (res) {
                    if (!res || !res.ok) {
                        setStatus('error', (res && res.error) || 'Search failed.');
                        return;
                    }
                    hits = {};
                    (res.matches || []).forEach(function (m) { hits[m.name] = m.count; });
                    var names = Object.keys(hits);
                    if (!names.length) {
                        searchHits.style.display = 'none';
                        setStatus('', res.complete
                            ? 'No day mentions "' + query + '".'
                            : 'No match yet — the sweep timed out before finishing.');
                        return;
                    }
                    searchHits.style.display = '';
                    searchHits.textContent = names.length + ' day(s) match "' + query
                        + '"' + (res.complete ? '' : ' (sweep cut short)')
                        + ' — click to open the newest';
                    searchHits.onclick = function () { selectDay(names[0]); };
                    setStatus('', 'Matches: ' + names.map(function (n) {
                        return (dayOf(n) || 'today') + ' (' + hits[n] + ')';
                    }).join(', '));
                    /* Reopen the picker so the counts are visible on
                     * the days themselves. */
                    renderMenu('');
                }).catch(function () { setStatus('error', 'Connection error.'); });
            }

            dayInput.addEventListener('focus', function () { renderMenu(''); });
            dayInput.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (dayMenu.hidden) { dayInput.value = ''; renderMenu(''); }
            });
            dayInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                menuIndex = -1;
                renderMenu(dayInput.value);
            });
            dayInput.addEventListener('blur', function () {
                /* Delay so a mousedown on an option is handled first. */
                setTimeout(closeMenu, 160);
            });
            dayInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
                var shown = dayMenu._shown || [];
                if (ev.key === 'ArrowDown' || ev.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    if (dayMenu.hidden) { renderMenu(dayInput.value); return; }
                    menuIndex += (ev.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1);
                    if (menuIndex < 0) menuIndex = 0;
                    if (menuIndex >= shown.length) menuIndex = shown.length - 1;
                    renderMenu(dayInput.value);
                    var active = dayMenu.querySelector('.day-opt.active');
                    if (active) active.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
                } else if (ev.key === 'Enter') {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    var pick = shown[menuIndex >= 0 ? menuIndex : 0];
                    if (pick) selectDay(pick.name);
                } else if (ev.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeMenu();
                    dayInput.blur();
                }
            });
            dayPrev.addEventListener('click', function () { stepDay(1); });
            dayNext.addEventListener('click', function () { stepDay(-1); });

            btnDownload.addEventListener('click', function () {
                window.location = '/cloud/instance/' + INSTANCE_ID
                    + '/log_archive/' + encodeURIComponent(archive);
            });

            /* ── Live toggle ── */
            function startLive() {
                if (liveTimer) return;
                fetchLogs();
                liveTimer = setInterval(fetchLogs, POLL_MS);
                btnLive.textContent = '⏸ Live';
                btnLive.className   = 'btn btn-live-on';
            }

            function stopLive() {
                clearInterval(liveTimer);
                liveTimer = null;
                btnLive.textContent = '▶ Live';
                btnLive.className   = 'btn btn-live-off';
            }

            btnLive.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (liveTimer) { stopLive(); return; }
                /* Live means the live file; jump back to it first. */
                if (archive !== LIVE) {
                    archive = LIVE;
                    syncDayInput();
                }
                startLive();
            });

            /* ── Service change ── */
            svcSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
                allLines = [];
                archive = LIVE;
                render();
                /* Sequential on purpose: fired together, the two calls
                 * race for the same rate-limit row. */
                loadArchives().then(fetchLogs);
            });

            /* ── Search ── */
            var searchTimer = null;
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                clearTimeout(searchTimer);
                searchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                    searchHits.style.display = 'none';
                    if (archive !== LIVE) { fetchArchive(); return; }
                    render();
                }, 200);
            });

            /* Enter in the filter box searches every archived day —
             * the one gesture that turns "I do not know the date" into
             * an answer. */
            searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
                if (ev.key !== 'Enter') return;
                ev.preventDefault();
                query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                if (archiveWrap.style.display === 'none') { render(); return; }
                searchAllDays();
            });

            /* ── Init ── */
            if (svcSelect.options.length) {
                loadArchives().then(fetchLogs);
            }
        })();
